# Spaced-repetition flashcards

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/flashcards/

Practice your own question-and-answer cards with a simple review schedule. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Paste English vocabulary and meanings as tab-separated pairs, then reveal and grade each answer.

## Limits and checks

The schedule is a simple learning aid, not a guarantee of retention. Session data can be exported and optionally saved locally.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
